svg.title: MangaTrans-Diffusion inference path
svg.desc: A source page is encoded by a frozen VAE into a latent. Chinese text and a box become a glyph image folded into 64 channels. The flow starts at the source latent plus half-scale noise. A sixteen-layer DiT, conditioned on time, predicts velocity over overlapping 64 by 64 latent tiles in a 30-step Euler loop. The result is decoded by the VAE and blended with the source page through a soft mask to give the translated page.
svg.text: source pixels bypass the model · outside the soft mask they are copied
